1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4 Nxd4 4.Nxd4 exd4.strategy: Takes the pawn with the queen, which stands centrally and cannot be chased away easily. White gets the more active position; Black is slightly passive but can hold with accurate play.
Develops with an eye on f7 and delays the recapture. The d4 pawn can still be taken later, but Black can now defend it with ...Qf6, so White has swapped a sure recapture for a lead in development.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4 Nxd4 4.Nxd4 exd4.name: Scotch Game: Napoleon Gambit
